name: Bärgunt-Hütte
kurzbeschreibung: **Bärgunt Hut** in **Mittelberg** – a cozy alpine refuge nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, just a short hike from the charming village of **Mittelberg**. Surrounded by breathtaking mountain scenery, this rustic hut offers warm hospitality, hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Käsespätzle**, and a fireplace that invites you to unwind after a day of hiking. Whether you're seeking adventure on the trails or simply a peaceful retreat, **Bärgunt Hut** promises an unforgettable alpine experience.
